title: Crunchy Chickpea Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with crunchy chickpea salad, perfect for a quick snack or meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mash chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add crunchy, quick, fix, and mexican to the bowl and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the wrap in the skillet for 1 minute on each side.
Spoon the chickpea mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
